column5: Debt 120%, deficit 4%, growth 4% (nominal) --> ratio falling.  Higher rates (say pushing the deficit on a path toward 8%) --> ratio rising.
Not sure about "sharply" but seems hard to lower debt-to-GDP at those interest rates without better growth prospects.
Hard to imagine any feasible austerity plan that would work at 7% or more, given the negative effect on real GDP growth and inflation.
column8: Credibility is the key, so "outside help" to keep borrowing cost down would be a critical element in success of any austerity plan.
